metadata.preprocessing: Median imputation, followed by StandardScaler; fit only on riders meeting the completed-delivery minimum. Missingness is reported separately and is not itself used as a cluster feature.

feature_policy.log_delivery_count: log1p of completed delivery count; included to represent volume with reduced skew.
feature_policy.mean_delivery_minutes: Mean valid completed-delivery time per rider.
feature_policy.late_rate: Share of valid completed deliveries strictly exceeding the configured 30-minute SLA.
feature_policy.mean_delivery_distance_km: Mean valid PS3 Haversine distance; missing if fewer than the required valid observations and median-imputed without a missingness-indicator feature.
feature_policy.mean_rider_rating: Mean PS3-valid 1-5 rating; missing if fewer than 5 ratings.
feature_policy.mean_multiple_deliveries: Mean non-negative integer multiple-delivery field; missing if fewer than 5 valid observations.
feature_policy.excluded_fields: Rider ID is a group key only; rider age is not tenure and is excluded; Type_of_vehicle is entirely missing in the supplied dataset; vehicle condition is excluded as a per-order operational attribute.
feature_policy.analysis_scope: Retrospective descriptive grouping of completed deliveries; not a prospective prediction or causal analysis.

silhouette_sample.sample_strategy: Uniform without-replacement rider sample with fixed random seed.

metadata.selection_method: Selected the inertia-elbow K because its silhouette is within 0.010 of the highest stable-candidate silhouette. All segments meet the rider-count stability screen; the selected profiles were reviewed for distinct measured operational characteristics.

segments.operational_description: delivery volume higher than the eligible-rider average; average delivery time higher than the eligible-rider average; late-delivery rate higher than the eligible-rider average; delivery distance lower than the eligible-rider average; average rider rating similar to the eligible-rider average; multiple-delivery load higher than the eligible-rider average

limitations: The 30-completed-delivery minimum is reused from PS3 rider reporting and is a screening threshold, not a guarantee of statistical stability.
The 30-minute SLA remains provisional; late rates change if the official SLA changes.
Average ratings and assignment-related fields are retrospective observations; they do not establish rider tenure or causal effects.
Rider IDs are pseudonymous grouping keys; segment membership is not an individual performance verdict or employment recommendation.
The supplied data does not document geography or time-period representativeness, and segment patterns may vary across contexts.
Features have varying availability; median-imputed feature values do not encode missingness in K-Means, while per-rider sufficiency flags preserve the data-quality information.
